title: Five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport
description: Five people are dead and five seriously injured after a Boeing 767-300 cargo plane "overran" the runway and caught fire, officials say.
content:

title: Austria's Islamic headscarf ban in force as under-14s go back to school
description: The government says the law is intended to protect the rights of young girls, but critics say it is fuelling anti-Muslim feeling.
content:
As the new school year begins in Austria, a law banning headscarves in schools for girls under 14 has gone into force.
